name: Python 3.13
initializeCommand: alias.devc-sync=!if [ -d .devcontainer/base/.git ]; then git -C .devcontainer/base pull -q --ff-only || echo 'devcontainer base: pull failed, keeping the existing clone' >&2; else git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/ddrinka/DevContainer .devcontainer/base || exit 1; fi; x=$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude); mkdir -p "${x%/*}"; for p in .devcontainer/base/ CLAUDE.md .devcontainer/devcontainer-lock.json; do grep -qxF "$p" "$x" 2>/dev/null || echo "$p" >> "$x"; done
